payload.text: CONDITIONAL on op ADD-03/2.1, which is not promoted: it conflicts with ADD-03/2.4 on VOL-I:8.9. ADD-03 2.1 deletes and replaces VOL-I 8.9 with a licence-or-Certificate requirement for each member incorporated outside the Kingdom, with the words 'A Proposal that does not include the evidence required by this Clause for each such member shall be rejected.' ADD-03 2.4 disapplies 2.1 for a member with not more than 10% and no design, construction or operation role, which instead submits 'the signed undertaking described in Volume I Clause 8.9 as issued'. The Q15 response says an undertaking is no longer accepted except from such a member giving its own. The effective VOL-I 8.9 at ADD-03 still allows an undertaking for any foreign member and states no consequence. Would rest on this if applied: row VOL-I-8.9-01 (requirement, consequence, Financial Close date rule), rows ADD-03-2.3-01, ADD-03-2.4-01 and ADD-03-2.5-01 ('paragraph (b)'), activity investment-licence, and the Table 8-1 lead times. Open questions for a person: how the replacement and the exception are recorded, and whether the rejection words reach a missing 2.4 undertaking. The existing Envelope A rules (ADD-02 7.2, VOL-I 6.2) concern other content and are not proposed as covering this. The clarification window has closed (VOL-I 5.2), so this is a bid decision. HUMAN DECISION PENDING.
